description: This file implements the Network plugin for WPEFramework, providing network interface management, IP configuration, event handling, and RPC methods for network operations.

classes.name: Network
classes.description: Main class implementing network management and RPC interface for WPEFramework.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the network plugin, registers event handlers.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up the network plugin, unregisters event handlers.

methods.name: getQuirks
methods.description: Returns quirks or special features supported.

methods.name: getApiVersionNumberWrapper
methods.description: Gets the current API version number.

methods.name: getStbIp
methods.description: Gets the IP address of the set-top box.

methods.name: isInterfaceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a network interface is enabled.

methods.name: setInterfaceEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a network interface.

methods.name: getNamedEndpoints
methods.description: Returns list of named network endpoints.

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Performs a network trace to an endpoint.

methods.name: traceNamedEndpoint
methods.description: Performs a trace to a named endpoint.

methods.name: setIPSettings
methods.description: Configures IP settings for an interface.

methods.name: getIPSettings
methods.description: Retrieves IP settings for an interface.
